items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: is a great guitar player, and Josephine Baker’s musical director

ctx.x: You are anticipating a question I had and that is let’s suppose the situation very suddenly got better and things returned, are there activities, types of gigs and so forth, that you might choose to not do again, that you were doing before?

I would question getting on an airplane for gigs that aren’t really on a certain level. And I’ve kind of graduated from doing the smaller gigs over the years, the smaller gigs, to more of the performing arts centers and you know, higher levels of jazz clubs and stuff like that. So I think I’ve been more selective about where I’d be playing. But the reality is that some of the smaller gigs are just going to go away. I mean some of these businesses are not going to be able to maintain their premises or whatever…
I did not know that, and I have to admit I had not heard this name.
